name: psf/requests v2.32.3 retrieval suite
notes: Natural-language questions with hand-checked line ranges at the pinned commit. 'author' records who wrote each query: queries written by someone who had just read the function list leak symbol knowledge, so results should also be reported per author. Queries with author 'claude-heldout' were written after the BM25 change was decided and were not used to make it; they share the author bias of the first 31 (same writer, who has read the code). Queries with author 'stackoverflow' are real question titles, copied verbatim from the top-voted python-requests questions on Stack Overflow (id = question id). They were picked in vote order by a fixed rule (keep a question only if one place in the requests source implements what it asks about; skip install/environment errors, comparisons with other libraries and repeated topics; stop at 15), set before any retrieval run on them. Ground truth was chosen by Claude, who has read the code.
